$comment: Receipt projection (docs/design/message-surface-and-meta.md C3) and the row's accessible name (C6 / §6). The core SDK hands every message a MessageReceiptView {status, readSummary?}; the kit only draws it, apps map nothing. Read by the four kit tests through each kit's messageReceiptPresentation and messageAccessibilityLabel pure functions and their MessageMeta / MessageStatus rendering. Copy keys name strings/*.json fields (Vue: message.<key without the message prefix>). Change the rules and the cases together.

rules.status: Five visual states. There is no delivered state: a single check means the server has the message, a double check means it was read (single chats). A host never maps a delivered state; the SDK projection does not have one.
rules.glyph: pending clock, sending spinner (reduced motion: static), sent single check, read double check in status.read (never the same shape as sent), failed alert. Glyph accessible names: messagePending, messageSending, messageSent, messageRead, messageFailed.
rules.readSummary: readSummary {readCount, unreadCount, total} exists only on the viewer's own messages in group conversations and only when the SDK has the data (empty for conversations above the large-group threshold). With a summary and status sent or read, the summary text replaces the check glyph: unreadCount > 0 → messageReadSummaryUnread with {count: unreadCount} ("{count} 人未读" / "{count} unread"); unreadCount == 0 → messageReadSummaryAllRead ("全部已读" / "Read by all"). pending, sending and failed keep their glyph and show no summary. No summary (single chats, big groups, no data yet): the glyph only; never a made-up number.
rules.readSummaryTap: When the host listens for readReceiptOpen the summary is a text button (hit area at least layout.touchTarget) that emits readReceiptOpen(messageId); otherwise it is plain text. Its accessible name is its text.
rules.summaryColour: unreadCount > 0: the meta text colour of its placement (onOutgoing tone inside an outgoing bubble, message.metaForeground elsewhere). All read: status.read (status.readOnOutgoing inside an outgoing bubble).
rules.incoming: Incoming messages never show a status glyph or a read summary.
rules.accessibilityLabel: One reading unit per message row, parts in this order, empty parts skipped: sender display name; content summary (the message preview, spec/message-preview-vectors.json); time (the bubble's clock text); for the viewer's own messages the status text (the glyph name above, or messageSendFailedRetry when failed) or, when a read summary replaces the glyph, the summary text. Parts are joined with the locale's list separator: "，" in zh, ", " elsewhere. Custom accessibility actions on the row: reply, open menu, and retry while failed.
